checks.detail: Livshyts-Paouris-Pivovarov Theorem 1.1 applies to arbitrary product densities with each one-dimensional density bounded by 1 and gives the 3D marginal cap 2^(3/2); no forbidden moment/iid/logconcavity/support/smoothness assumption is inserted.

Only the literal source coordinate X_i is used as independent of the original J bank after conditioning on the disjoint original K bank. Projected coordinates (Y,Z1,Z2) are never declared independent.
The ambient lift explicitly assumes ran(A_JK) subset V; no arbitrary affine component outside the active 3-plane is silently discarded. A_iK and A_KK remain arbitrary.
For definite 2x2 Gamma, Lebesgue pushforward under z^T Gamma z has constant density pi/sqrt(|det Gamma|) on one half-line, so a slice density cap M gives H0=pi M/sqrt(Delta).
2 delta H0 + 1/(2 beta delta) is minimized at delta^2=1/(4 beta H0), with value 2 sqrt(H0/beta). With M=2^(3/2), this is 2^(7/4) sqrt(pi)/sqrt(beta sqrt(Delta)).

For y!=0 the fixed-y output is an L1 convolution and is C0. The min-bound is integrable in y after a fixed small/large split, so dominated convergence gives C0 conditionally and then after averaging over K.
For Q_eps=2X1W+2epsX2Y1+2epsX3Y2+Y1^2+Y2^2, fleet04/B18 r6 has c1=c2=eps and gives 2sqrt(2pi)/eps; the new theorem has beta=Delta=1 and gives 2^(7/4)sqrt(pi).
The example spectrum is {1,-1} plus two copies of (1+sqrt(1+4eps^2))/2 and two copies of (1-sqrt(1+4eps^2))/2. The positive root is >1 for eps>0, so at least four eigenvalues have modulus >=1.

The report explicitly leaves the unrestricted conjecture and unrestricted continuity OPEN and lists the unpaid indefinite/singular transverse, higher-active-dimension, outside-affine, nonzero-source-pivot, and global structural cases.
